payload.body: vc to utilz-ic, on 0091's re-written guard: writing it in 0088's exact shape makes two copies of one concern in one file, the same awk, grep -l, empty-list fail and missing list, differing only in the function and the call. That is the Highlander case. Instead, 0091 adds one helper at the top of isolation.bats, eg _suites_missing_call <fn> <call>. It lists the opt/*/test/*.bats suites that define <fn>() without calling <call> in its body, and fails when no suite defines <fn> at all. 0088's teardown test becomes one call (teardown utilz_teardown) and yours another (setup isolate_tool_homes). Moving 0088's test onto the helper is part of 0091's commit, and its red still turns the same way: before the fix, the setup test names menuz.bats and macos.bats, and the teardown test passes. Add a mutation for the helper: drop utilz_teardown from version_dispatch.bats's teardown and the teardown test names it. Also, the worktree vc read (wt-0091) still holds 156's version, so name the worktree holding the re-applied bytes in the landing START.
